description: Figure 8 is a pie chart that illustrates the time cost breakdown before and after the implementation of efficient deployment. The chart is divided into two segments. The larger segment, colored orange, represents the "Reduction" in time cost, which is 60.9 seconds, accounting for 69.92% of the total time. The smaller segment, colored blue, represents the "Efficient deployment" time, which is 26.2 seconds, accounting for 30.08% of the total time. The chart visually demonstrates that the efficient deployment method significantly reduces the overall time cost, with the reduction component being the dominant part of the total time.
